purpose: Every link inside a message shown in Dyk is automatically clickable.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: Owner decision given in the controlling session on 2026-10-11 and recorded on Dyk #485 (comments 6110172257 and 6110231320): instead of a message-to-task link, "when AI (or regex) finds link in message it automatically makes from it html link clickable". The owner reversed the related manual-edit removal ("stop. Leave the manual date change." and then chose to leave all manual task editing as is), so this campaign only renders links and changes no task editing. Bounded rendering change; visible results are represented in Storybook in the same PR and independently reviewed before merge. PRs only, never merge or deploy; no production access. No limits; provider subscription limits and the no-progress guard are the stops. Providers Claude then Codex.

constraints: No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions, paid services, or Playwright and other browser-driven tests (Dyk owner rule). Local disposable SQL only through the repository runners (npm run test:sql / npm run journeys with a selected scope) when a task changes a route or persistence; never the production database.

Keep the affected Storybook stories in sync with every renderer change (Storybook is not post-hoc documentation). RU/EN/HE, true Hebrew RTL, 320/390 widths, 44px hit areas, no horizontal overflow, truthful states (T2).
Never read .env contents, credentials, private conversations or real user data; fixtures are synthetic.
A Storybook build or passing tests is not visual acceptance; each PR lists the story ids for independent visual review and states that the visual verdict is pending.

Do not remove worktrees, delete branches or link another checkout's node_modules. Do not add any new blocking gate, lock, required approval or check that depends on owner-provisioned keys, credentials or setup (Dyk AGENTS.md section 4).

Do not touch app/src/people-copy.js or app/src/consumer.js beyond what an item strictly needs: open PR #500 rewrites them. Coordinate with the running campaign dyk-followups (people-view.js, Setup plan-limit, check-approved-design.js) by not editing those files.
Never weaken an existing test, guard or assertion. Do not change any task editing behavior (date, title, action, summary, Done/Undo, person correction): the owner decided to keep it as is.

tasks.title: Links inside messages are automatically clickable everywhere messages are shown
tasks.outcome: Every http(s) URL in a shown message becomes a safe clickable link in the reader, task evidence, Setup chat preview and Summary history.
acceptance: Every item is done or reported not applicable with evidence; affected focused tests, the selected HTTP journeys on disposable SQL where a route changed, npm run check:ui, audit-principles and npm run storybook:build plus the storybook node tests pass, with exact commands; the PR lists story ids for independent visual review.
tasks.goal: Owner decision (Dyk #485 comments 6110172257 and 6110231320): "when AI (or regex) finds link in message it automatically makes from it html link clickable". Audit every surface that renders original message text: the chat reader (Sources), task evidence quotes in Tasks details, the Setup contextual chat preview and Summary history evidence. Where URLs are not yet linked, render them with the existing safe text-links helper (render/append: only http, https, mailto and tel; javascript:/data: stay plain text; target and rel=noopener as existing links do; no innerHTML, keep the escaping guard passing). Preserve message direction (RTL/LTR) and bidi isolation. Add focused tests per surface (linked, unsafe scheme not linked, RTL message) and Storybook states showing a message with a link in RU/EN/HE.
